verdict_reason: The test only adds the organisation header and a blanket pass-through stub, so no test fails if register, list or session stop scoping by organisation, and the header is sent to endpoints that never read it.

todos.issue: The new organisation check on register (DocumentController.register) and list (DocumentController.list) is untested: the @BeforeEach at :77-80 stubs requireTraderAccess to pass for every ref and org, and no test makes it throw. Deleting notificationService.requireTraderAccess(ref, organisationId) from either endpoint leaves every test green. DocumentControllerIT has no cross-organisation case for documents either, so nothing proves the AC 'a user in organisation A cannot see or change a notification that belongs to organisation B' for document uploads. The session endpoint (GET /notifications/{ref}/document-upload-sessions/{correlation-id}), which also gained the check, has no test in this file at all.
todos.fix: Must: for register and list (and the session lookup), a test fails if the endpoint stops scoping by the caller's organisation: when the notification belongs to another organisation the response is 404 and documentService is never reached; and a request without Trade-Imports-Organisation-Id is refused with 400. One way: in Register and ListDocuments add a test that stubs doThrow(new NotFoundException(...)).when(notificationService).requireTraderAccess(REF, "5900002") and asserts status().isNotFound() plus verify(documentService, never()).registerUpload/findByNotificationRef; add one missing-header test asserting 400; or add the cross-organisation case to DocumentControllerIT against a real notification owned by another org.

todos.issue: The organisation header is added to requests on endpoints that never read it and sit outside TraderOrganisationHeaderFilter (which only filters /notifications paths): every Claim test (:203, 228, 250, 263, 275, 289, 300, 314, 331, 352, 368), GetByUploadId (:448, 464) and ScanResult (:484, 503, 522). ScanResult is the cdp-uploader callback, which never carries a trader organisation. The header tells the reader these endpoints are organisation-scoped when they are not, and removing it changes no outcome.
todos.fix: Must: a test sends Trade-Imports-Organisation-Id only to endpoints that read it (register, list, session), so the requests show which endpoints are organisation-scoped. One way: delete the .header(...) line from the Claim, GetByUploadId and ScanResult requests.

todos.issue: allowTraderNotificationAccess (:77-80) stubs a void method on a @MockitoBean with doNothing(), which is already what the mock does, so it is set-up that changes nothing and implies the check needs opting into. The same stub is copied verbatim into DocumentControllerTrailingSlashTest.java:55. The org id literal "5900002" is also repeated inline at 23 request sites (:94 through :522) with no name saying it is the caller's organisation.
todos.fix: Must: no set-up line that has no effect, no copy of it in a second test class, and one named constant for the caller's organisation id used at every request site. One way: delete the @BeforeEach here and in DocumentControllerTrailingSlashTest; add private static final String CALLER_ORGANISATION_ID = "5900002" (or reuse a shared fixture such as UploadSessionFixtures) and use it in each .header(...).
